customManagers.description: Container images pinned by tag and digest in workflow env vars ending in _IMAGE, in the workflows of CELIAN and of the golden repo (spec 001, research RS-17)

packageRules.description: Principle VI, ADR-016: these registries give Renovate no release date, so it cannot count the 7 days. Each update waits on the Dependency Dashboard: only Lucas ticks it, never an agent, once the upstream release of the proposed digest is 7 days old, or at once for the fix of a published advisory.
